turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or time grain by hour of day: checkout activity is only available by day or coarser (the closest metric is checkout_sessions, site sessions with a checkout, by day), so I cannot say which hour was the busiest or how many checkouts it had.
